svg.title: Worked LZ77 example on the string a a c a a c a b c a b a a a c
svg.desc: Five encoding steps of LZ77 on the string "aacaacabcabaaac" with dictionary size at most 6 and buffer size at most 4. Each row shows the sliding dictionary in teal, the matched substring in amber, and the next literal character in coral, together with the emitted token. Step 1: no dictionary yet, emits (_, 0, a). Step 2: matches "a" at distance 1, emits (1, 1, c). Step 3: matches "aaca" at distance 3, emits (3, 4, b). Step 4: matches "cab" at distance 3, emits (3, 3, a). Step 5: matches "aa" at distance 1, emits (1, 2, c).
